sections.MESSAGE_TO_USER:
**[#196561](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/196561): please hold the merge.** mboetger left three inline comments a few minutes before his "Overall LGTM." approval. Two of them say part of our change is factually wrong. I've asked matt561 to test that claim on a device. Nothing has been pushed, so all three approvals and the green CI still stand.

**Comment 1, line 113 ([r4606831206](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/196561#discussion_r4606831206)): "nit: toBigIntegerOrNull() exists"**
- He's right. The Kotlin standard library has `String.toBigIntegerOrNull()`, and it would replace our try/catch around `BigInteger(value)`. It's a style change only.
- My view: it isn't worth losing the approvals and rerunning an hour of presubmits for this alone. If we push for comments 2–3 anyway, I'll include it, once matt561 confirms it parses the same inputs. Otherwise it can go in a follow-up.

**Comments 2–3, line 152 ([r4606860038](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/196561#discussion_r4606860038)):**
> I don't think this is true. Can't submit to Play Store sure - but I was able to install with adb.
> I believe it will reject if you try to install over a build with a versionCode.

- This is about the KDoc on `errorMessage`. The KDoc says APKs built with `-P force-version-code-ignoring-abi=true` and no positive `versionCode` are ones "Android refuses to install". That is our reason for leaving the flag out of the error message.
- If mboetger is right, Android does install them on a clean device and only rejects installing over a build that has a `versionCode`. Then the flag does help some users, for example local `adb install`. In that case the fix may be more than wording: the error message might need to suggest the flag, with the Play Store and upgrade caveats. That would change the user-facing text we're about to cherry-pick into 3.50 and 3.51.
- His claim hasn't been tested yet. I won't call this a wording nit or a follow-up until matt561's test results come back.

**What matt561 is doing now (nothing will be pushed):**
- Building with the flag where neither `android {}` nor the manifest has a `versionCode`.
- Reading the `versionCode` in the built APKs.
- Running `adb install` on a clean emulator, then installing over a build that has a `versionCode`.
- Checking our other claim, that AGP fails the build when the value isn't a decimal integer.
- Drafting the `toBigIntegerOrNull()` change locally and checking it parses the same inputs.

**Merge recommendation:** wait for the results. The PR is going into two release branches, and fixing the message before it lands is cheaper than landing it and then cherry-picking a second fix. If the test shows only the wording is too strong and the behavior is right, I'll come back with one question: push the fix now (approvals dismissed, about an hour of presubmits), or merge as-is and follow up. Before I call it ready again, I'll re-run `pr_triage.dart` and re-fetch all review threads.

**Replies to mboetger:** he's a human reviewer, so I'll draft replies here for you to post. I won't post anything on GitHub. Draft for comment 1, to post now or later:
> Good call, thanks. Switching to `toBigIntegerOrNull()` [in this PR / in a follow-up].

I'll draft the reply to comments 2–3 when the test results are in, so it can state what we found and what we're changing.

Reply "hold" to confirm the merge stays paused until the results are in.
sections.WORKER_BRIEF:
<WORKER-BRIEF>

**Task: test whether a reviewer's claim is true on flutter/flutter#196561. Do not push and do not post on GitHub.**

PR: https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/196561 ("Fix --split-per-abi versionCode when android {} omits versionCode")
Branch: `vcfix-manifest-fallback` on the `reidbaker-agent` fork, head `f3d2ab1fd3b`. Confirm your local head matches that commit before you start.

The PR has three approvals (reidbaker, bkonyi, mboetger) and green CI. Any push dismisses all three approvals and reruns about an hour of presubmits, and reidbaker wants to cherry-pick this into 3.50 and 3.51. So: **do not push, force-push, or open anything.** You may commit locally. mboetger is a human reviewer, so **do not reply to his comments on GitHub.** Put any draft reply in your report.

**Review comments, verbatim:**

Comment 1, `ManifestVersionCodeTaskHelper.kt` line 113, https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/196561#discussion_r4606831206 (mboetger):
> nit: toBigIntegerOrNull() exists

The code it is on:
```kotlin
val versionCode =
    try {
        BigInteger(value)
    } catch (e: NumberFormatException) {
        null
    }
```

Comments 2 and 3, one thread on `ManifestVersionCodeTaskHelper.kt` line 152, https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/196561#discussion_r4606860038 (mboetger):
> I don't think this is true.  Can't submit to Play Store sure - but I was able to install with adb.

> I believe it will reject if you try to install over a build with a versionCode.

The code that thread is on:
```kotlin
/**
 * Formats the `--split-per-abi` error for [variantName] when `android {}` omits `versionCode`
 * and reading the main manifest fails ([reason]).
 *
 * Does not suggest `force-version-code-ignoring-abi`, because it cannot help here. When the
 * manifest has no positive `versionCode`, the flag builds APKs with no `versionCode`, which
 * Android refuses to install. When the value is not a decimal integer, AGP fails the build.
 */
internal fun errorMessage(variantName: String, reason: String): String = ...
```

Background: `-P force-version-code-ignoring-abi=true` is a Gradle property that skips this PR's per-ABI versionCode logic entirely.

**Status of the claims:** mboetger says such APKs install with adb but are rejected when installed over a build that has a `versionCode`. The KDoc says Android refuses to install them, and that AGP fails the build when the value isn't a decimal integer. **None of these claims has been reproduced.** Don't assume either side is right. Test each one.

**What to do:**
1. Make a test app with no `versionCode` in `android {}` and no positive `versionCode` in the main manifest. Build with `flutter build apk --split-per-abi -P force-version-code-ignoring-abi=true`. If that combination doesn't reach the flag, record what happens instead.
2. Read the `versionCode` of each built APK (`aapt2 dump badging` or `apkanalyzer manifest version-code`). Record the exact output, including whether it is missing or 0.
3. On an emulator without the app, run `adb install` with the matching ABI APK. Record the full command and output, and the emulator's API level.
4. Install a build of the same app ID with a positive `versionCode` (for example 1). Then install the step-1 APK over it. Record the output (for example `INSTALL_FAILED_VERSION_DOWNGRADE`).
5. Set the manifest `versionCode` to a non-decimal value. Check whether AGP fails the build, as the KDoc says. Record the error.
6. Comment 1: write the `toBigIntegerOrNull()` change in a **local commit only**. Check that it accepts and rejects the same inputs as `BigInteger(value)`: leading `+`/`-`, whitespace, empty string, non-ASCII digits, very large values. Run the existing tests for this helper.

**Report back with:**
- The commands and outputs for each step above.
- For each KDoc claim: confirmed, wrong, or partly wrong.
- Your view, with reasons, on whether code (should the error message suggest the flag, with caveats?), tests, or docs (the KDoc) must change. This is not decided yet, so don't write that change until I reply.
- Whether the `toBigIntegerOrNull()` change behaves the same, and the local commit SHA.
- Draft replies to both mboetger threads, for reidbaker to post.
